##: DevWS handles its own same-account UAC elevation. The uninstaller is intentionally skipped during Scoop updates; those must run DevWS setup as an upgrade, not a full uninstall.
description: A configuration-driven workspace orchestrator for Windows.
notes: DevWS requires Windows 11 x64, PowerShell 7, and a genuine stable Windows Terminal installation.

Run Scoop from an elevated PowerShell under the same Windows account that should own DevWS. A non-elevated Scoop invocation is not validated for this bucket. UAC elevation using another administrator account is intentionally rejected.
The installer is unsigned and may trigger Microsoft Defender SmartScreen. Download only from the official GitHub Release and verify the published SHA-256.
If a trusted machine-wide AutoHotkey v2 installation is missing, DevWS setup acquires it through WinGet; network access is required.
Uninstall uses the protected DevWS setup registered for the current Windows account, not the Scoop-downloaded installer.

script: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $setup -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'DevWS setup download is missing.' }
if (-not $p) { throw 'DevWS setup did not start.' }
if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "DevWS setup exited with code $($p.ExitCode)." }

post_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $key)) { throw 'DevWS did not register under the current Windows account.' }

script: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $key)) { Write-Host 'DevWS is not registered for the current Windows account; nothing to uninstall.'; return }
if ($uninstall -notmatch '^"([^"]+)"\s+--uninstall$') { throw 'The DevWS uninstall registration is malformed.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'The registered DevWS uninstall executable is missing.' }
if (-not $p) { throw 'DevWS uninstall did not start.' }
if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "DevWS uninstall exited with code $($p.ExitCode)." }
